p: Cush: By Phut and Lud are meant Africa and Libya.
Syene shall they fall in it: Which was a strong city of Egypt, Eze 29:10.
shall be darkened: Meaning that there will be great sorrow and affliction.
yokes of Egypt: That is, the strength and force.
eleventh year: Of the captivity of Jeconiah, or of Zedekiah's reign.
I have broken the arm of: For Nebuchadnezzar destroyed Pharaoh Nebo at Carchemish, Jer 46:26.
his arms: His force and power.
when I shall put my sword: By which we see that tyrants have no power of themselves, neither can do any more harm than God appoints and when he wills they must cease.
